newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.302 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.302 pct.

text.p: The annual yield on the latest issue of Swiss federal government three-month money market claims is 1.302 percent, down from the previous issue's 1.332 percent, the Swiss federal treasury in Berne said.
The latest issue, to be paid for on October 17, raised 726.15 million Swiss francs and was priced at 99.672 percent.
The previous issue of three-month claims, paid for on October 10, raised 913.85 million francs and was priced at 99.667 percent to yield 1.332 percent annually.
